name: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited
summary: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate and infrastructure development business in India. It engages in the construction, development, and sale of residential and commercial properties; project management; and rental of properties. The company also sells freshwater and treated sewage to industrial customers.
